The frame stays outside, so the Carolingian paintings are not shown. This replaces the St. Moritz lake shore, already published. The Open-Meteo model is mainly clear and cool, about 10°C, with cloud cover a little under three-tenths, a light wind, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
